items.text: Cbse's Circular of 24 January Cbse's Circular of 24 January CBSE's circular of 24 January 2017 covers candidates with disabilities under the 2016 Act, including those it calls physically handicapped. Ask your school for the version in force this year.

rows: A scribe, compensatory time or both. For a three-hour paper the extra time is 60 minutes, and it is 50 minutes for 2.5 hours, 40 for two hours and 30 for 1.5 hours. The scribe should not hold qualifications in the subject, and the candidate may choose the scribe.
Ask the school to record the facility at registration.
Candidates with 2016 Act disabilities may study one compulsory language instead of two, within the three-language formula, and then choose four other subjects.
Check how this affects college eligibility before you choose.
Physiotherapy exercises are treated as equivalent to the Board's Physical and Health Education course.
Ask the school to record your physiotherapy.
Exemption is available to candidates with disabilities defined in the 2016 Act.
